#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Animated ASCII cat for the console. """
import time import os import sys
# Define animation frames for the cat cat_frames = [ # Frame 1: Cat at rest, eyes open """ |\\_/| (=^.^=) "" "" """,
# Frame 2: Cat blinking """ |\\_/| (-^.^-) "" "" """,
# Frame 3: Cat eyes closed (wink) """ |\\_/| (=^.~) "" "" """,
# Frame 4: Cat at rest, eyes open again """ |\\_/| (=^.^=) "" "" """,
# Frame 5: Cat with raised paw """ /\\_/\\ (=^.^=) "| |" """,
# Frame 6: Cat back to normal """ |\\_/| (=^.^=) "" "" """,
# Frame 7: Cat with tail swish (looking left) """ /|\\_/| (=^.^=) "" "" """,
# Frame 8: Back to normal """ |\\_/| (=^.^=) "" "" """, ]
def clear_screen(): """Clear the console screen.""" os.system('clear' if os.name == 'posix' else 'cls')
def print_cat_animation(duration=10, frame_delay_ms=300): """ Print animated cat.
Args: duration: Total duration of animation in seconds (0 = infinite) frame_delay_ms: Delay between frames in milliseconds """ frame_delay_sec = frame_delay_ms / 1000.0 start_time = time.time() frame_index = 0
try: while True: # Check if we should stop (if duration is specified and not 0) if duration > 0 and (time.time() - start_time) > duration: break
# Clear screen and print current frame clear_screen() print("\n" * 2) # Add some top margin print(cat_frames[frame_index % len(cat_frames)]) print("\nFrame", (frame_index % len(cat_frames)) + 1, "of", len(cat_frames))
# Move to next frame frame_index += 1
# Wait before next frame time.sleep(frame_delay_sec)
except KeyboardInterrupt: # Allow clean exit with Ctrl+C clear_screen() print("\n Cat animation stopped! Goodbye!\n") sys.exit(0)
if __name__ == "__main__": # Check for command line arguments duration = 0 # 0 means infinite delay = 300 # 300ms between frames
if len(sys.argv) > 1: try: duration = int(sys.argv[1]) except ValueError: print("Usage: animated_cat.py [duration_in_seconds] [delay_in_ms]") sys.exit(1)
if len(sys.argv) > 2: try: delay = int(sys.argv[2]) except ValueError: print("Usage: animated_cat.py [duration_in_seconds] [delay_in_ms]") sys.exit(1)
print(" Starting cat animation...") print(" Press Ctrl+C to stop\n") time.sleep(1)
print_cat_animation(duration=duration, frame_delay_ms=delay)
